content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bellevue

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience hours. Review PMI's education and work-hour requirements to confirm you meet the credential's baseline qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive, instructor-led sessions on your schedule. This formal education covers all five process groups and knowledge areas PMI tests, and fulfills the mandatory contact-hour requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee to activate your eligibility window for sitting the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice questions, strategy sessions, and study guides—to reinforce the bootcamp content. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center and take the computer-based exam when ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your credential active. Pursue training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or other PMI-approved activities aligned with your career growth and your local job market.
